line: Crowley on Atu XV: the letter Ayin, Capricornus ruled by Saturn, Pan Pangenetor, and Atu XIII and XV from Tiphareth (pdf p95).

sections.title: Letter, sign and figure
sections.line: Crowley on the letter Ayin, Capricornus, Saturn as its ruler, and Pan Pangenetor (pdf p95).

quotes.quote: This card is attributed to the letter ‘Ayin, which means an Eye, and it refers to Capricornus in the Zodiac.
The sign is ruled by Saturn, who makes for selfhood and perpetuity.
The card represents Pan Pangenetor, the All‐Begetter.

sections.title: Atu XIII and XV on the Tree
sections.line: Crowley on Atu XIII and XV, symmetrically placed on the Tree of Life and leading from Tiphareth (pdf p95), and on the Paths that join the ten numbers (pdf p36).

quotes.quote: On the Tree of Life, Atu XIII and XV are symmetrically placed; they lead from Tiphareth, the human consciousness, to the spheres in which Thought (on the one hand) and Bliss (on the other) are developed.
